podcast.body: A solo album by Gord Downie was announced in late September 2017, with recording sessions having wrapped up in February of the same year. This album was released after his glioblastoma diagnosis. "Well, they must have been, especially after we heard about a solo album in late September 2017. ... Sessions for that album wrapped up in February."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album, mentioned after Gord's death, featured 23 songs, each dedicated to a specific person. One song was directed at his brother Pat, a fellow Boston Bruins fan, reflecting Gord's lifelong passion for hockey. "A final solo album. 23 songs, each dedicated to a specific person."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This double album was a surprise announcement on September 28, 2017, with a release date of October 27, 2017. Although the sessions for the album had been completed in February of that year, its unexpected announcement led to speculation that Gord's cancer treatments might be working. "There would be a new solo album entitled Introduce Yourself on October 27th. Surely this meant that the chemo and the radiation and all the other treatments were working. Gord's well enough to make a double album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
